name: Vox Populi
description: The region's own press, in its own language — what the local reader sees

macros.f1: Please sweep the native-language press — the Vox Populi scan.
macros.f2: What is the local-language press leading with today?
macros.f3: Any story the international press is not carrying?
macros.f4: Translate the front page of the leading local outlet.
macros.f5: Which region should I point you at? Ask me, then sweep.
